explication: Dynamo is a datacenter-scale inference orchestration layer for coordinating inference engines across GPUs and nodes. Its principal workflow accepts inference requests, routes them to engine workers, and returns generated output; documented capabilities add KV-aware routing, disaggregated prefill/decode, and SLA-driven autoscaling. The graph also includes the engine integration and performance-model layers. Several subsystem links reflect README-level capability descriptions rather than inspected call sites, so only documented relationships are shown.
